input: message contains ASCII lowercase letters and spaces, with 1 <= length <= 10000, and limit is an integer in [1,10000]. Collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse/accessor-backed collections. Strings are ordinary/primitive strings. Every collection length and computed allocation size fits [0,4294967295], with padded sizes explicitly included. No concurrent mutation or built-in monkey-patching is allowed. Preconditions are not runtime-checked, and allocation/resource capacity or completion is not guaranteed by declared bounds. JavaScript integer inputs are primitive safe-integer Number, excluding negative zero, NaN, infinities, fractions and BigInt.
return: Fresh array of the minimum number b of contiguous message parts suffixed <a/b>. All nonfinal strings have exactly limit characters; the final string has at most limit. Removing suffixes and concatenating recovers message exactly. Returns an empty array if impossible.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and caller-held aliases remain unchanged; working state is private. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: For b parts, total body capacity is b*(limit-digits(b)-3)-sum(digits(a),a=1..b). Candidates are scanned rather than binary-searched because denominator digit growth can reduce capacity. All products/counts are below 10^8. Positive last-part capacity is required; minimality ensures earlier full parts do not exhaust the message. All integer inputs/intermediates remain within [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(m*log(m+1)+m) time and O(m+b*log(b+1)+1) auxiliary/output space for message length m and chosen b, counting decimal conversions, suffix construction, slicing and all result characters. b<=m; impossible cases return without output construction. Bounds include ordinary built-in operations/allocations and assume bounded-word arithmetic, constant-time indexing, amortized append/pop and any explicitly stated hash/sort behavior.
source_accounting: The complete standalone source is 859 UTF-8 bytes, including every helper, Solution wrapper, signature, loop, built-in call, annotation/comment, whitespace and terminal newline. Helpers are fully charged per candidate, not free shared libraries. No imports, runtime-generated implementations or hidden source expansion are used. Any eventual judge-interface adapter is additional charged source.
evidence_boundary: Authored permitted dev_fit alternative outside frozen source sets. Membership checked only against already-public cost-decomposition-v1/contract.json partition.dev_fit and candidate manifest. Input/effect/complexity declarations are not frozen-predecessor equivalence receipts. No candidate execution/import, behavioral qualification, benchmark acceptance or M1/M2 pass is claimed. Mandatory isolated judging remains blocked; private original source/case/receipt material is unavailable. Static syntax/metadata checks do not establish correctness. Independent source-bound isolated qualification must cover tiny limits, one part, final partial part, exact capacity, transitions at 9/10 and 99/100 parts, spaces, impossible suffix overhead and full reconstruction, actual return types, numerical/Unicode and effect contracts, full source/adapter charges and complexity before admission or promotion.
